segments.name: Device Segment
segments.description: Develops, seeks regulatory approval for, and commercializes adult and pediatric Selective Cytopheretic Devices for critically ill patients with organ failure.
segments.evidence: The Company is comprised of a single reportable segment, its Device Segment.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals in the United States purchase the QUELIMMUNE therapy after completing the SAVE Surveillance Registry process.
revenueModel.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we had 10 active commercial hospital customers that have completed the process for the SAVE Surveillance Registry and have purchased QUELIMMUNE therapy.
